patterns.content: Typed properties and constructor promotion: class User { public function __construct(private readonly string $name, private int $age) {} } — no body needed for simple DI.
Enums (PHP 8.1+): enum Status: string { case Active = 'active'; case Inactive = 'inactive'; } — replaces class constants. Backed enums have a value.
Fibers (PHP 8.1+) and never type (PHP 8.1+). Use match expression instead of switch: match($x) { 1 => 'one', 2 => 'two', default => 'other' } — strict, no fall-through.
Null coalescing: $value = $input ?? 'default'. Null coalescing assignment: $arr['key'] ??= 'init'. Nullsafe operator: $user?->getAddress()?->getCity().
Named arguments: str_contains(haystack: $text, needle: 'foo'). Useful for functions with many optional params — skip positional order.
Union types and intersection types: function process(int|string $id): User|null. Use mixed only when genuinely mixed — not as a lazy escape from typing.
Readonly classes (PHP 8.2): readonly class Point { public function __construct(public float $x, public float $y) {} } — all properties readonly implicitly.
Generators for lazy sequences: function rangeGen(int $start, int $end): Generator { for ($i = $start; $i <= $end; $i++) yield $i; } — avoids building full array in memory.
Exceptions: throw new \InvalidArgumentException('msg'). Catch specific types, not \Exception. Use finally for cleanup. PHP 8 allows throw as expression.
PSR-4 autoloading: one class per file, filename matches class name. Composer handles autoload. Never require_once manually for class loading.
